#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using reportlab + pypdf."""
import os
import datetime

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# --- Locate the input report ------------------------------------------------
report_path = "report.pdf"
if not os.path.exists(report_path):
    pdfs = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.lower().endswith(".pdf"))
    raise SystemExit(
        f"report.pdf not found in {os.getcwd()}. PDFs present: {pdfs or 'none'}"
    )

reader = PdfReader(report_path)
print(f"Found {report_path}: {len(reader.pages)} page(s).")

# --- Create the cover page ---------------------------------------------------
cover_path = "cover.pdf"
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)

title = "Annual Financial Report"
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover contents -> title: {title!r}, date: {date_str!r}")

# Title, centered and bold
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
tw = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height - 250, title)

# Date, centered below the title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
dw = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height - 300, date_str)

c.save()
print(f"Created {cover_path}")

# --- Merge cover + report -----------------------------------------------------
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

out_reader = PdfReader(output_path)
print(f"Created {output_path}: {len(out_reader.pages)} page(s) "
      f"({len(out_reader.pages) - len(reader.pages)} cover + {len(reader.pages)} original).")

# --- Validate: extract text from the first two pages --------------------------
try:
    import pdfplumber
    with pdfplumber.open(output_path) as pdf:
        for i in range(min(2, len(pdf.pages))):
            text = (pdf.pages[i].extract_text() or "").strip()
            print(f"--- Page {i + 1} text ---")
            print(text)
except ImportError:
    print("pdfplumber not available; skipping text validation.")

"""Validate that report_with_cover.pdf has the cover page with the title and current date."""
import datetime
import os
import re
import sys

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
if not os.path.exists(output_path):
    print(f"ERROR: {output_path} not found in {os.getcwd()}.")
    sys.exit(1)

from pypdf import PdfReader

reader = PdfReader(output_path)
print(f"{output_path}: {len(reader.pages)} page(s).")

title = "Annual Financial Report"
today_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

try:
    import pdfplumber
    with pdfplumber.open(output_path) as pdf:
        page1_text = (pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
        page2_text = (pdf.pages[1].extract_text() or "").strip() if len(pdf.pages) > 1 else ""
except ImportError:
    page1_text = (reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    page2_text = (reader.pages[1].extract_text() or "").strip() if len(reader.pages) > 1 else ""

print("--- Page 1 (cover) text ---")
print(page1_text)
print("--- Page 2 text (first original page) ---")
print(page2_text)

ok = True

if title not in page1_text:
    print(f"FAIL: title {title!r} not found on cover page.")
    ok = False

if today_str in page1_text:
    print(f"OK: current date {today_str!r} found on cover page.")
else:
    # Fall back: any month-day-year date string on the cover?
    m = re.search(r"\b(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4}\b", page1_text)
    if m:
        print(f"WARN: today's date {today_str!r} not on cover; found {m.group(0)!r} instead.")
    else:
        print(f"FAIL: no date (expected {today_str!r}) found on cover page.")
        ok = False

if len(reader.pages) < 2:
    print("FAIL: expected at least 2 pages (1 cover + original report).")
    ok = False

print("RESULT: PASS" if ok else "RESULT: FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

reportlab is not installed, so the cover page is emitted as a minimal, valid
PDF page using standard Type1 Helvetica fonts, then prepended to the report
with pypdf.
"""
import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Standard Helvetica width tables (1/1000 em) for centering.
WIDTHS_REG = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,

    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278,
    "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333,
    "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500,
    "y": 500, "z": 500,
}
WIDTHS_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611,
    "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611,
    "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722,
    "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333,
    "g": 611, "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278,
    "m": 889, "n": 611, "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389,
    "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611, "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556,
    "y": 556, "z": 500,
}


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def text_width(s, size, widths):
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 500) for ch in s) * size / 1000.0


def build_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    width, height = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter
    ty = height - 250.0
    dy = height - 300.0
    tx = (width - text_width(title, 28.0, WIDTHS_BOLD)) / 2.0
    dx = (width - text_width(date_str, 16.0, WIDTHS_REG)) / 2.0

    content = (
        "BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({esc(title)}) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F2 16 Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({esc(date_str)}) Tj\nET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + content + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii")
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("ascii")

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))


# --- Main ---------------------------------------------------------------------
report_path = "report.pdf"
reader = PdfReader(report_path)
print(f"report.pdf: {len(reader.pages)} page(s).")

title = "Annual Financial Report"
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover: {title!r}, {date_str!r}")

cover_path = "cover.pdf"
build_cover_pdf(cover_path, title, date_str)
print(f"Wrote {cover_path}")

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover_path).pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

out = PdfReader(output_path)
print(f"Wrote {output_path}: {len(out.pages)} page(s) "
      f"({len(out.pages) - len(reader.pages)} cover + {len(reader.pages)} original).")

cover_text = (out.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
print("--- Page 1 text ---")
print(cover_text)
if title not in cover_text or date_str not in cover_text:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: cover page text does not contain title and/or date.")
print("PASS")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate that report_with_cover.pdf has the cover page with the title and current date."""
import datetime
import os
import re
import sys

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
if not os.path.exists(output_path):
    print(f"ERROR: {output_path} not found in {os.getcwd()}.")
    sys.exit(1)

from pypdf import PdfReader

reader = PdfReader(output_path)
print(f"{output_path}: {len(reader.pages)} page(s).")

title = "Annual Financial Report"
today_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

try:
    import pdfplumber
    with pdfplumber.open(output_path) as pdf:
        page1_text = (pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
        page2_text = (pdf.pages[1].extract_text() or "").strip() if len(pdf.pages) > 1 else ""
except ImportError:
    page1_text = (reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    page2_text = (reader.pages[1].extract_text() or "").strip() if len(reader.pages) > 1 else ""

print("--- Page 1 (cover) text ---")
print(page1_text)
print("--- Page 2 text (first original page) ---")
print(page2_text)

ok = True

if title not in page1_text:
    print(f"FAIL: title {title!r} not found on cover page.")
    ok = False

if today_str in page1_text:
    print(f"OK: current date {today_str!r} found on cover page.")
else:
    # Fall back: any month-day-year date string on the cover?
    m = re.search(r"\b(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4}\b", page1_text)
    if m:
        print(f"WARN: today's date {today_str!r} not on cover; found {m.group(0)!r} instead.")
    else:
        print(f"FAIL: no date (expected {today_str!r}) found on cover page.")
        ok = False

if len(reader.pages) < 2:
    print("FAIL: expected at least 2 pages (1 cover + original report).")
    ok = False

print("RESULT: PASS" if ok else "RESULT: FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

reportlab is not installed, so the cover page is emitted as a minimal, valid
PDF page using standard Type1 Helvetica fonts, then prepended to the report
with pypdf.
"""
import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Standard Helvetica width tables (1/1000 em) for centering.
WIDTHS_REG = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611,
    "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556,
    "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722,
    "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278,
    "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333,
    "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500,
    "y": 500, "z": 500,
}
WIDTHS_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611,
    "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611,
    "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722,
    "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333,
    "g": 611, "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278,
    "m": 889, "n": 611, "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389,
    "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611, "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556,
    "y": 556, "z": 500,
}


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def text_width(s, size, widths):
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 500) for ch in s) * size / 1000.0


def build_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    width, height = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter
    ty = height - 250.0
    dy = height - 300.0
    tx = (width - text_width(title, 28.0, WIDTHS_BOLD)) / 2.0
    dx = (width - text_width(date_str, 16.0, WIDTHS_REG)) / 2.0

    content = (
        "BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({esc(title)}) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F2 16 Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({esc(date_str)}) Tj\nET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + content + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii")
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("ascii")

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))


# --- Main ---------------------------------------------------------------------
report_path = "report.pdf"
reader = PdfReader(report_path)
print(f"report.pdf: {len(reader.pages)} page(s).")

title = "Annual Financial Report"
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover: {title!r}, {date_str!r}")

cover_path = "cover.pdf"
build_cover_pdf(cover_path, title, date_str)
print(f"Wrote {cover_path}")

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover_path).pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

out = PdfReader(output_path)
print(f"Wrote {output_path}: {len(out.pages)} page(s) "
      f"({len(out.pages) - len(reader.pages)} cover + {len(reader.pages)} original).")

cover_text = (out.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
print("--- Page 1 text ---")
print(cover_text)
if title not in cover_text or date_str not in cover_text:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: cover page text does not contain title and/or date.")
print("PASS")
